spans.s:
1. रोध, अस्, m. sprouting, growing, &c.; [cf.
2. अव-र्˚, न्यग्-र्˚.]
—रोधावरोध (˚ध-अव्˚),
probably ‘moving up and down.’

2. रोध, अस्, m. (for 1. रोध see col. 1), the
act of stopping, checking, arresting, restraining,
hindering, impeding, preventing, &c.; restraint,
stoppage, obstruction, suppression, prevention, pro-
hibition; shutting up, confining; closing, blocking
up; siege, blockade (of a town); attacking, making
war upon; a dam, bank, shore [cf. रोधस् below];
a proper N.; N. of a hell.
—रोध-कृत्, त्, m. epi-
thet of the forty-fifth year in the Jupiter cycle of sixty
years.
—रोध-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (rivers) forming
eddies on the bank, (Sāy. = रोधन-शीलानि चक्राणि
यासु.)
—रोध-वक्रा, f. = रोधो-वक्रा.

रोध 2. रोध, रोधस्, रोधिन्, &c. See
p. 850, col. 2.

रोधक, अस्, इका, अम्, stopping, checking, re-
straining, confining, shutting up, besieging, block-
ading.

रोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, obstructing, impeding, being
an obstacle or hindrance; (अस्), m. the planet Mer-
cury; (आ), f. = रोधस्; (अम्), n. the act of stop-
ping, checking, restraining, preventing, impeding,
oppressing; the act of confining, confinement, re-
straint; besieging, blockading.

रोधस्, अस्, n. a bank, embankment, dam, ob-
struction; a mound, high bank, wall, a shore; the
brink of a well; a flank, epithet of a woman's hips;
[cf. तट.]
—रोधः-पतन-कलुष, अस्, आ, अम्,
(rendered) muddy by the falling in of a bank.
—रो-
धस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having high banks
(said of rivers; Ved.); (अती), f., N. of a river.
—रोधो-वक्रा, f. ‘winding along its banks,’ a
river.
—रोधो-वती, f. ‘having banks,’ a river.
—रोधो-वप्र, अस्, m. a rapid river.

रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, stopping, checking, restraining,
hindering, preventing, prohibiting; shutting up,
closing; destroying; a species of plant, (gender
doubtful.)

रोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stopped or checked,
to be restrained, &c.

रोध्र रोध्र, अस्, m. (probably connected
with rt. 1. रुध् and रुधिर), the tree Symplocos
Racemosa (having yellow leaves; the red powder
thrown over persons during the Holī festival is pre-
pared from the bark of this tree); (अम्), n. sin, (in
this sense also अस्, m.); offence, injury, (in these
two senses probably connected with rt. 2. रुध्.)
—रोध्र-पुष्प, अस्, m. Bassia Latifolia; a species
of ringed snake.
—रोध्र-पुष्पक, अस्, m. a
kind of grain (said to be a sort of शालि); a species
of ringed snake.
—रोध्र-पुष्पिणी, f. Grislea To-
mentosa.
—रोध्र-शूक, अस्, m. a kind of rice
(the ears of which are similar in colour to the flowers
of the Rodhra).
